entities.name: Jean-Marie Kélétigui
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean-Marie Kélétigui was the Ivorian bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Katiola from 7 July 1977, until his retirement on 10 October 2002. He was named Bishop Emeritus of Katiola until his death in 2010, aged 78.
